review: The integration alternative needs a migration experiment that isolates framework behavior from business correctness and avoids simultaneous framework adoption.
build: Wrap one existing service in a LangChain tool and compare it with the plain adapter under the same fixtures. Translate both streams into the same application event schema. Run equivalent read-only tasks through the three local framework-neutral reference strategies, then deny the tool and inject a forbidden write effect.
verify: The UI and ownership tests pass for both implementations. Record the specific capability gained and measured complexity, latency, and failure-handling changes. Run `python3 -B labs/framework_contract_compare.py`; record expected sourced answer and negative tool outcome. These toy strategies do not benchmark actual LangChain, ADK or the other named SDKs.
